_comment: Brand keys that denote the same business. Curated, never generated: similarity alone cannot tell 'mi store' (Xiaomi) from 'sm store' (The SM Store). Canonical is the variant the sources use most, so display names follow the evidence. Candidates are proposed into 2_clean's normalization_review.csv; a pair only lands here after a human agrees. Keys are the output of brand_key(), i.e. lowercased and punctuation-folded.

nuat thai foot body massage: nuat thai foot and body massage
peri peri charcoal chicken sauce bar: peri peri charcoal chicken and sauce bar

_rejected._comment: Pairs that scored above the similarity threshold and are NOT the same business. Recorded so they are not re-proposed and re-argued every time the review file is read.
_rejected.mi store / sm store: Xiaomi's Mi Store and The SM Store. 0.875 similarity, unrelated companies.
_rejected.techno / tecno: TECNO is a handset maker; 'Techno' is used by unrelated computer shops.
_rejected.kettle corn / kettle korn: 'Kettle Korn' is a branded chain; 'kettle corn' is also the generic product, used by independent vendors.
_rejected.bpi / bpi atm, bdo / bdo atm: A branch and an unattended ATM are different tenant formats. Merging them was a past mistake, deliberately undone.
_rejected.mcdonalds / mcdonalds dessert center: A dessert kiosk is a separate outlet format from a restaurant.
_rejected.bee healthy lemon / healthy lemon, candy: Plausibly the same, not established. Left for evidence rather than guessed.
